tolerance: Objects compared over the keys given in expected; arrays element by element with equal length; numbers |a - e| <= 1e-9 * |e| (purely relative, so an expected 0 must be exactly 0); everything else exactly (SPEC §10).
not_benchmarked: Fingerprint algorithm and exact fingerprint values (approve:true only asserts a matching fingerprint).
Content of the restored_values warning; warnings are omitted from every case flagged restore_replaces.
Whitespace-padded vocabulary values (e.g. ' office '): §2 trims texts, §10 demands exact match.
Arrays or objects given for text fields (§10 converts only null, booleans and numbers).
Number texts with a signed exponent sign other than plain digits beyond '1e3', numbers overflowing to infinity, and number-to-text conversion of non-integers or exponent notation.
Blocked state combined with decision_status approved.
Float boundary equality with non-dyadic products (e.g. 3 x 0.1 vs 0.3); boundary cases use exactly representable values.
Localisation, rendering, PDF, project package and handoff behaviour.
Exit-count requirement when exit_count_threshold is null but exit_count_threshold_3 is exceeded is asserted as null (AMBIGUITIES D2); a page returning 3 would fail x3-05.
